annotations.title: Read the public panel for a country and vertical

description: Read SocialSeal's public panel for one market (US, SG or GB) and vertical: rising topics with a search-demand label (strong, indicative or untested), reference videos ("x usual" only for a creator outlier, otherwise views per day against the cell median), Video DNA structure stats with their sample size and an indicative flag, creators to watch, and the latest captures of each panel search. Each section carries its collection date; a stale section is left out and named in hiddenSections. Free, needs no workspace, and never charges credits. Only panel searches' own videos and creators are listed; other data appears only as aggregates. Reads stored evidence/configuration; no provider collection or collection charge. Preserve returned timestamps, coverage, missing evidence and errors. Synchronous; no polling unless the result explicitly supplies continuation.
name: socialseal_get_panel_cell
